journal_lines: §cSmelled the nest before anything was visible. §oSilk hung in sheets across the tunnel mouth. Cleared it.
§aEgg sacs along the back wall, half-hatched. §lString§a everywhere after. Still worth it.
§cWeb thick enough to catch a paw. Moved carefully, then not carefully. Came out sticky.
§oThe young ones had not learned what wolves were yet. They learned.
§aFound the center chamber. Dense work. §lSpider§a silk pulled loose by the yard.
§cSomething large in the back of the nest. Dealt with it. The hazard was real.
Colony under a fallen log — more of them than the log suggested. Cleared the whole thing.
§aCame home with silk in the fur. The fur will keep. §lNest§a will not.
